name: personalised-fitness-assistant
description: Food logging, macro calculator, exercise search and a community feed. React client + Express/MySQL API.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix client && npm ci --prefix server/server
scripts.build: npm ci --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm ci --omit=dev --prefix server/server
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server/server && npm test --prefix client -- --watchAll=false
